items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Kelly's Stable in New York with Thelma Carpenter, a great singer.

ctx.x: With the group and after that these kids that wanted all Pittsburghers - Art Blakey said to me, "Well, it's good he's gone because there's a guy in Pittsburgh that's the greatest." I said, "O.K., we'll go by and pick him up." We had another engagement, I think through John Hammond, Kelly's Stable in New York with Thelma Carpenter, a great singer. What happened, they brought in a guy from Pittsburgh and the boy couldn't even play the parts. See, Hal Baker was so terrific and he'd take about 10 choruses.
